thread:
lena: Canary promote for ai-ingress v3.1.2 -> staging tripped a secrets validation in preflight. deploy-bot flagged mismatch between secret keys and chart values. promo auto-held. anyone on this?

deploy-bot: promote-blocked: preflight-secret-schema, error=missing key 'tls.crt' in secret ai-ingress-tls; merged-values reference expects tls.crt and tls.key; action=hold. see /artifacts/3067894321/logs

omar: looking now. staging overlay switched to use k8s-managed certs (useK8sCert=true) but chart still expects explicit tls keys when useK8sCert=false. merge ended up referencing tls.* regardless.

tia: oh right i merged the overlay change to flip to useK8sCert to avoid manual certs during tests. forgot to update chart values schema. my bad.

ben: options: 1) hotpatch the merged values in deploy artifact to set useK8sCert=true and remove tls.* refs (fast, but ephemeral), 2) pin staging to previous chart v3.1.1 and abort promote (safe), 3) revert overlay change and re-run after PR (takes ~20m).

lena: for production we should not promote without explicit TLS keys unless chart supports k8s cert mode. prefer pin now and fix chart/values.

omar: agree. we'll pin staging to 3.1.1. tia please open PR to update values schema and add a preflight check that ensures tls.* only required when useK8sCert=false.

tia: opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/901 - updates values schema, adds conditional validation to the preflight job. ETA ~18m.

ben: i'll draft release-note fragment: "Staging promo to v3.1.2 deferred; pinned to v3.1.1 due to values/secret schema mismatch after switching to k8s-managed certs. PR#901 adds schema guard. Hotfix window Thu 11:00 UTC for re-promo."

lena: aborting current promote and pinning staging now. @deploy-bot record manual_pin.

deploy-bot: action=manual_pin, user=lena, reason="preflight failed: secret key tls.crt missing due to overlay flip to k8s-managed certs", pinned_version=3.1.1, timestamp=3067894330

lena: audit commands:
```
# check preflight logs
cat /artifacts/3067894321/preflight.log | sed -n '1,200p'
# abort promote job
kubectl -n deploybot logs job/deploy-promote-3067894321 --tail=150
# rollback staging release
helm rollback ai-ingress 1 -n staging
# annotate pinned release
kubectl -n releases annotate release ai-ingress promoted-by=lena manual-pin-reason="secret schema mismatch"
```

tia: PR linked to the release and added the preflight unit test. will follow up to re-run promote once merged.

omar: adding a small CI lint to catch secrets schema drifts between overlays and chart schema.

ben: thanks all. I'll update release notes and notify platform owners. :white_check_mark:
